subject: Frequently Asked Questions: Understanding your security alerts
body:
Hi Assem,

As part of our ongoing account protection efforts, we occasionally send automated alerts when we detect changes to your account, such as sign-ins from new devices or updates to your recovery information.

Q: Why did I get an alert for a device I recognize?
A: New alerts can trigger after browser updates, VPN use, or clearing cookies, which can make a familiar device look 'new' to our systems.

Q: What should I do if I don't recognize an alert?
A: Visit your account settings directly (not via email links) to review recent activity and update your password if needed.

These alerts are informational and don't require action unless you notice something unfamiliar.
